decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building unless otherwise specified on the submitted and approved drawings.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Flood Risk Assessment and Design and Access Statement received 16/05/2011 and 1341/P001, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 102A, 103, 104A, 105A and 106 received 17/06/2011, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment received 16/05/2011 and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Extension to the existing basement including provision of a front and rear lightwell and rear basement access in the garden and the refurbishment of an existing rear extension incorporating new glazing to flank and rear walls, alterations to the roof, and rearward extension of southern flank wall of existing rear extension.
